text:
Maya: kicking off sync re: joint perf/W + throughput run with Arcadia Systems. goal is a clear marketplace listing and a co-announcement after we validate kernel tweaks and SI configs. timeline thoughts?
Jordan: sounds good. i'd like a dry-run first with our internal trace set, then a partner smoke test. estimate 2 weeks?
Ken: agree on dry-run. main risks: kernel patch stability and power telemetry accuracy on their boards. we should lock telemetry schema before runs.
Lia: i'll own the telemetry schema. can someone post the minimal fields we need? cpu_pmu, gpu_power_w, board_temp_c, p_state, fan_rpm, kv_cache_hit_rate, output_tokens_per_sec.
Maya: perfect. also need to define the measurement matrix: model configs, sequence lengths, batch sizes, quant/ops. propose: 3 models (mix of 7b/13b open weights), seq=[512,1024,2048], batch=[1,4,8], quant=[fp16,4bit-qat].
Emily: add a sustained throughput test (30m steady traffic) and an end-to-end latency tail (p99) run. include warmup and cache priming.
Jordan: for kernel tuning, Arcadia wants a patchset that toggles fused-attn + improved GEMM layout. we'll run before/after delta. need a rollback plan in case of regressions.
Maya: noted. liaison with SI: @ArcadiaFieldEng will run HW validation, but we should supply a docker image + runscript. Ken, can you assemble the image?
Ken: yes. i'll base off rwi/base:bench-v2 and include our perf tool and the telemetry agent. sample run command:
```
./rwi_bench --model=gpt-7b --seq=2048 --batch=8 --iters=100 --trace=kv --telemetry-endpoint=http://telemetry.local:9000
```
Lia: telemetry agent will accept JSON lines with schema v1. i'll attach the template to the shared drive after this thread.
bench-bot: Scheduled job 4823 (dry-run) for 2026-04-01T10:00:00Z on arcadia-dev-01. logs will stream to /runs/4823.
Maya: awesome. coordination items: 1) telemetry schema (lia), 2) docker image (ken), 3) test matrix and runbook (jordan+emily), 4) external comms + marketplace blurb draft (maya). owner/ETA for each?
Jordan: i'll have the runbook draft by EOD Wednesday. i'll include expected KPIs and acceptance gates for perf/W improvements (>=10% perf/W or <5% latency regression).
Ken: image pushed to ghcr by Tue morning, will include kernel-compat tags.
Lia: telemetry schema draft by Tue noon.
Emily: i'll draft the marketplace blurb and joint announcement outline by Fri. want legal looped? probably yes for partner quote.
Maya: yes include legal + comms. also flag any embargo windows for Arcadia marketing.
Jordan: quick question on metrics: do we use energy-metered board readings as ground truth or rely on their BMC? i'd prefer a calibrated power meter in the loop for final numbers.
Ken: agree. dry-run can use BMC, final validation must have an external meter. i'll coordinate with Arcadia logistics.
Maya: thanks. last note: keep logs short and preserve raw traces in object storage for audits. we'll run canary marketplace listing after final signoff. :thumbsup:
Emily: :thumbsup: i'll circulate next steps and a calendar invite for a 30m sync once dry-run is scheduled.
Maya: thanks everyone — let's iterate in the doc and ping here for blockers.
_meta: Generated Slack thread for joint performance benchmarking with hardware partner (Arcadia Systems).
